sandbachFocus: Sandbach United, currently top of the table with 22 points from 10 games, face Alsager Town at home on Saturday 3 October (KO 15:00). Despite a recent loss, Sandbach's season remains strong with seven wins and a draw in their last ten. They then travel to face Cheadle Heath Nomads on Saturday 10 October (KO 15:00) in what will be another test of their title credentials.
divisionWide: Second-placed Stafford Town (20 points) host Dawley Town on Saturday 3 October, while third-ranked AFC Bridgnorth visit Eccleshall in another key fixture. Wolverhampton Casuals, also on 19 points, travel to Wednesfield Community on Saturday 3 October. The mid-table battle sees Bilston Town (17 points) at home to Foley Meir, Barnton hosting Shawbury United on 10 October, and Allscott Heath visiting Brereton Social on 10 October. Bottom-half strugglers include struggling Widnes Town (2 points) away at Brereton Social on 3 October, while Cheadle Heath Nomads (7 points) host Telford Town (6 points) on 3 October—a clash between two of the division's lowest scorers. Crewe entertain Allscott Heath on 10 October, and Market Drayton Town (12 points) host New Mills (14 points) on 3 October before visiting Widnes Town on 10 October. Shawbury United, currently on a five-game losing run, face Market Drayton Town away on 3 October before hosting Alsager Town on 10 October. Sandbach's midweek fixture at home to Wednesfield Community takes place on Wednesday 7 October (KO 19:45).
